comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Backlog candidate for next webhook epic; no commitment this quarter yet.

content.text: Backlog candidate for next webhook epic; no commitment this quarter yet.
Teams that only care about bugs in project ALPHA currently create separate subscriptions or filter in their own service. That multiplies secrets and delivery noise for high-volume workspaces.
Allow a single subscription to declare include_project_keys and include_issue_types arrays. Events that fail the filter are dropped before fan-out and do not count against delivery quota.
Acceptance: empty arrays mean no restriction; unknown project keys rejected at write time; changing filters does not drop in-flight deliveries; OpenAPI and webhook console UI updated together.
